name: io.github.ohneben/activecampaign-mcp
title: ActiveCampaign
description: ActiveCampaign API: ~325 endpoints (v3, SMS, WhatsApp, Segments) as safety-categorized MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Server transport. Set to 'stdio' for local MCP clients; the image otherwise starts the Streamable HTTP transport.

environmentVariables.name: ACTIVECAMPAIGN_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your account's API URL, copied from ActiveCampaign -> Settings -> Developer, e.g. https://your-account.api-us1.com/api/3

environmentVariables.name: ACTIVECAMPAIGN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your ActiveCampaign API token (same Developer screen).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Only for MCP_TRANSPORT=http: bearer token required on /mcp. Without it a non-loopback bind refuses to start.
